title: sdk: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes and v1.175.0 version bumps
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: Bring Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to parity for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics ahead of the v1.175.0 release. This consolidates behavioral differences discovered in downstream clients and fixes a couple of race conditions in streaming clients that caused flakiness in long-lived streams. Summary of changes: 1) Standardize auth provider interface and refresh token flow across SDKs so automatic token refresh is consistent; 2) Unify retry policy defaults (idempotency detection, backoff, max attempts) and expose a clear configuration API; 3) Improve streaming client ergonomics: stable async iterator in Python, proper backpressure handling in TS, and context-friendly stream cancellation in Go; 4) Parity fixes for function calling/structured output serialization; 5) Version bumps to v1.175.0 for all SDK packages and update changelogs. Checklist: ensure unit and integration tests for each SDK; update docs and examples; smoke test Hosted API against new clients; coordinate release notes and package publishes. Testing: added cross-sdk fuzz tests for auth token rotation and streaming replay; ran full CI and a canary publish to the internal package registry. Rollout: after merge will publish staggered packages over 48h with monitoring on error rates and latency.
commits: Refactor: extract AuthProvider interface and shared helpers
feat(sdk): unified retry policy and config surface
fix(streaming): stabilize async iterator and add backpressure hooks
chore(release): bump versions to v1.175.0 and update changelogs
test: add cross-sdk auth rotation fuzz tests
docs: update SDK auth and streaming ergonomics guides
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice cleanup on the auth interface. Two comments: can we keep the old env var fallback for a deprecation cycle? Also prefer 4xx vs 5xx handling for idempotency checks.
Aisha Kumar: Added env var fallback as an optional compatibility shim and documented deprecation window. Updated idempotency handling per suggestion.
Diego Ramirez: Streaming change LGTM but found a race in TS when client closes mid-chunk. Suggested adding an explicit drain before destroying the stream.
Aisha Kumar: Added a drain step and an extra unit test that simulates mid-chunk close; CI caught a flaky case which is now fixed.
Sofia Chen: Can you add a small note in the console about the version bump and any breaking config defaults?
ci_checks: e2e streaming canary: pass after rerun
merge: Merged by Aisha Kumar via squash merge after approvals from reviewers. Merge commit message: 'sdk: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; bump v1.175.0'. Release coordinated with engineering release calendar; packages scheduled for staged publish.
release_notes: - SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go): unified auth provider and automatic token refresh behavior; standardized retry defaults and exposed retry configuration. - Streaming clients: improved ergonomics and backpressure handling; fixed race conditions causing stream flakiness. - Function calling and structured output parity fixes across SDKs. - Bumped package versions to v1.175.0 across Python, TypeScript, and Go. See docs/sdk-auth.md and docs/sdk-streaming.md for migration notes.
